plainTranslation: Easy emotional understanding with a little complementary difference. You read each other well and your needs mesh without friction. Failure mode: assuming you're identical and missing where you differ. Use the rapport, stay curious about the gaps.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your emotional needs fit together easily. Home feels natural with them. This is quiet, durable compatibility.
tension: The challenge is that emotional understanding can create a false sense that nothing needs to be said. Because you often pick up on each other so easily, you may assume the other person already knows they are loved, appreciated, or important. Over time, that assumption can quietly replace expression. The connection still feels good, but it may stop deepening because neither person is putting words or actions around what they feel.
advice: Being understood is not the same as feeling valued. People still need evidence of care, even when the bond feels obvious. This connection grows when you turn quiet understanding into something visible and consistent.
summaryShort: Your emotional needs fit together easily.
